name: Helmet Of Salvation
overview: The helmet of salvation, as described in Isaiah 59:17 and Ephesians 6:17, symbolizes the protective assurance believers have through God's saving work. Salvation is portrayed as a vital defense for the mind, guarding against spiritual attack by grounding believers in the gospel—the power of God unto salvation for all who believe (Romans 1:16). This salvation is secured by faith in Christ, who was given by God to grant eternal life (John 3:16), and is to be embraced confidently as part of the believer’s spiritual armor, strengthened by the Lord's might (Ephesians 6:10).
